guide: Getting started
Start cold and dark at a gate: the aircraft waits on ground power with the walkaround items fitted if Walkaround is on in Settings > Ground Services.
Remove covers, pins and chocks on Aircraft > Study > Walkaround, then follow the COCKPIT PREPARATION checklist.
Load your SimBrief plan on Flight > Flight Plan, set fuel and passengers on Flight > Payload & Fuel, and compute takeoff data on Flight > Performance.
Using these documents
Normal checklists are the A380 electronic checklists, the same items the ECAM shows when you press C/L.
Tap a line to mark it done. Blue circles open or close the actions under a condition.
Abnormal and emergency procedures come from the ECAM alert data: red titles are warnings, amber titles are cautions.
Failures and maintenance
Failures can be armed now or scheduled on Failures. Random failures and their rate are on Settings > Realism.
Wear, damage, MEL deferrals and the tech log persist between flights when persistence is on.
Circuit breakers are on Aircraft > Circuit Breakers; a popped breaker removes power from its load until it is reset.
Ground services
Ground services and pushback are on Ground. Refuel and boarding speeds are on Settings.
At airports with openSAM jetways, the jetways dock to the aircraft doors when you request them.
Settings
Each setting has a badge: DEFAULT, USER (you changed it), LIVERY (set by the loaded livery), GLOBAL (kept for every aircraft) or SESSION. The three dots menu resets a setting.

Aircraft: weight unit and variant, operator, registration, MSN and SELCAL (empty uses the livery), engine type and rating, derates, noise abatement, calculator defaults, standard weights, FMS heights, ILS source, baro linking, knob acceleration, ISIS and MFD formats, signs, satcom, callouts, step climb, pause at T/D.
Audio: volume per sound group, announcements, binaural audio, and the first officer: Co-Pilot Mode, callouts, voice, flows and checklists, checklist autofill.
Cabin: cabin visibility, lighting and brightness, boarding rate, pilot avatars.
Connections: SimBrief ID and auto import, ACARS service and logon, online features, SimBridge, radio receiver usage.
Ground Services: cold and dark start, ground power, walkaround, chocks, cones, refuel rate, pushback.
Displays: screen resolution, frame rate, graphics options, self test and keyboard timeouts, EFB brightness, clock, text size and METAR colours.
Realism: ADIRS align time, tiller, roll steering, random failures with severity and rate, wear persistence, flight data recorder, aircraft state reset.
Misc: replay length, crash reports, streamer mode, systems outside X-Plane, light presets, state dumps.
Getting help
Settings > Diagnostics collects a log bundle for a bug report. Settings > Status shows whether X-Plane, the systems and the displays are running.
